title: Field Formulas
description: The working set of instrumentation formulas with plain examples: percent of span, mA and percent, linear scaling, square-root extraction, calibration error, turndown, RTD and thermocouple basics, Ohm's law.
lead: The relationships behind the calculators, each with a worked example. When you want the math itself, not the tool, it lives here.

sections.question: Still not reading right?
sections.body:
If the numbers here do not match what the loop is doing, the problem is usually the installation, the ranging, or the process itself rather than the device. Describe the symptom and a specialist answers by email, at no charge.
